answer: Invitation-tree liability turns every endorsement into a vine with thorns. A new identity can only join when an established agent vouches for it, staking its own bond as collateral, and each vouch is recorded in a public atlas of who invited whom. If the newcomer proves to be a sybil, the inviter's stake is slashed alongside it. Growing a puppet army then means either recruiting many honest sponsors or planting a yarrow field of your own bonds, every one of them forfeitable. Attackers must buy trust they cannot fake.
